title: Real Estate License Research Assistant | Part-Time | $4/hr
description:
Apply here: 

Complete the Daily Dials Admin application at the link above.



Two agents have the same name. Can you tell which license belongs to which person? Daily Dials is hiring a part-time research assistant to verify U.S. real estate license records. This is a remote, non-voice role at $4 USD per hour, with a target of 20 hours per week.



What you’ll do

• Look up agents in public state licensing databases and verify the original license date, license status, and license number when available.

• Use city, brokerage, or license number to distinguish people with similar names.

• Record verified details and source links in Google Sheets. Flag unclear matches for review.



What you’ll need

• Comfort researching across browser tabs and working in Google Sheets.

• Care with names, dates, and conflicting records, plus clear written English for short research notes.

• A computer and reliable internet. Prior experience with U.S. real estate records is helpful and optional.

title: Fractional AI Specialist — Automation, Agents & Workflow
description:
Fractional AI Specialist — Automation, Agents & Workflow

Visture Property Group · Peterborough, ON, Canada Remote-friendly (Canada) with occasional on-site help · Fractional / 6-month initial contract with renewal and/ full time employment possibilities. Compensation: based on experience 

 

About us

Visture is a vertically integrated property management and construction company — roughly 225 doors under management and several million in annual construction — built on strong operating discipline (EOS) and a values-first culture. We’ve done the strategy and we know exactly where we’re going: we’re becoming an AI-native company, and we’re looking for the builder to help us get there.

The role

This is an AI-first, hands-on build role. You’ll design and ship AI agents and automations across our business — leasing, sales/estimating, maintenance, finance, and construction — wire them into the tools we already use, and put sensible guardrails around them. This is the core of the job and where ~80% of your time goes.

It is not a traditional IT / help-desk / network role. We run entirely on Google Workspace and cloud tools — there are no servers to maintain. The only “IT” we need is light: helping us structure our Google Workspace cleanly and setting up reliable access to AI models for the team. If you’re a strong AI builder who’s comfortable with that light setup work, you’re exactly who we want.

What you’ll do

Build and ship AI workflows and agents — one at a time, prove them, then scale.

Connect our existing tools so data flows: Buildium, QuickBooks Online, Co-construct, Float, Google Workspace, and ClickUp (our command centre).

Stand up dependable access to AI models for the team — cloud APIs, and open/local models where they make sense.

Build in guardrails: human approval where money or compliance is involved, plus logging and a clear audit trail.

Light Google Workspace structuring (files, access, shared drives) so the foundation is clean.

Coach our team to actually use what you build — adoption, not just pilots.

What we’re looking for

Demonstrated experience building AI / automation — agents, LLM APIs, and no-code/low-code tools (e.g. Zapier, Make), with real integrations between business systems.

A pragmatic, ship-it builder: start small, prove value, scale what works.

A safety/governance instinct — you think about what could go wrong and design for it, especially anything touching money or customers.

Comfort moving data between platforms cleanly and securely.

Clear communicator who can work with non-technical operators and explain trade-offs plainly.

Enough general tech comfort to handle light Google Workspace administration. (You do not need to be a network engineer or sysadmin.)

Bonus points

You’ve helped a small or mid-sized company actually adopt AI — not just run a pilot.

Experience standing up open-source / local models.

Familiarity with property management or construction software (Buildium, Co-construct, QBO, ClickUp).

Data-integration, security, or governance background.

To apply

Send your resume and a short note answering one question: What’s a manual, repetitive workflow you’d automate first, and how would you keep it safe? (A few sentences is plenty — we want to see how you think.)

We review every application and respond to every applicant.

title: Homecare inbound sales specialist
description:
Home care inbounds sales specialist

Help Families Navigate One of the Most Important Decisions They May Face

Our agency is looking for a Homecare inbound sales specialist to support families who are exploring care for an aging loved one and help guide them from their first inquiry to a Care Consultation with our team.

Families often contact us during a stressful or uncertain time. They may be worried about a parent living alone, overwhelmed by caregiving responsibilities, or unsure what type of support is available.

You will often be the first person they speak with.

We are looking for someone who can listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions, provide reassurance, explain our services clearly, and help families determine the right next step.

This is also a highly organized, results-oriented role. Success requires disciplined follow-up, accurate lead tracking, strong documentation, and a commitment to making sure no prospective client falls through the cracks.

What You’ll Do

As our Homecare inbound sales specialist, you will manage inquiries from prospective clients, family members, referral sources, and others seeking information about home care services.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Speaking with families about the challenges they are experiencing with an aging loved one

• Listening carefully and asking questions to understand the family’s needs, concerns, urgency, and decision-making process

• Explaining how home care works and how our services may be able to help

• Building trust and rapport with families who may be stressed, emotional, uncertain, or unfamiliar with senior care

• Identifying the appropriate next step for each inquiry

• Converting qualified inquiries into Care Consultations

• Following a defined and disciplined lead follow-up protocol

• Proactively following up with families who are interested in care but are not yet ready to move forward

• Maintaining consistent contact until there is a clear outcome

• Accurately entering and updating lead information in Salesforce

• Maintaining detailed notes regarding family circumstances, care needs, decision-makers, concerns, timing, and next steps

• Tracking every inquiry through the lead pipeline and ensuring that no opportunity is lost because of incomplete follow-up

• Prioritizing inquiries based on urgency, family needs, and readiness to move forward

• Working within WellSky to review client information and support the intake process

• Coordinating with internal team members to ensure a smooth transition from inquiry to Care Consultation and start of care

• Taking ownership of each lead and being accountable for the next step

• Tracking activity and outcomes, including inquiries, follow-ups, Care Consultations scheduled, and lead conversion

What We’re Looking For

• Excellent English-speaking and communication skills are required

• Previous Salesforce or other CRM experience is required

• Previous WellSky experience is preferred

• Previous experience in sales, home care, senior care, healthcare, admissions, intake, customer service, or another consultative service environment is strongly preferred

• You are an excellent listener and can make people feel comfortable discussing personal and emotional situations

• You communicate with warmth, confidence, and professionalism

• You are comfortable speaking with adult children, spouses, seniors, and other family decision-makers

• You can explain services clearly without sounding scripted or overly sales-oriented

• You understand how to guide a conversation toward a decision or next step

• You are comfortable asking questions, addressing concerns, and following up consistently

• You understand that many families will not make a decision after one conversation

• You are highly organized and able to manage multiple leads at different stages of the decision-making process

• You are disciplined about completing follow-up when promised

• You are detail-oriented and maintain accurate documentation

• You can recognize when a family needs immediate assistance and when a lead may require longer-term nurturing

• You take initiative and do not need to be reminded to follow up

• You are dependable and take ownership of your results

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of calls you answer.

It is measured by how effectively you help families move through the process of evaluating home care.

A successful Homecare inbound sales specialist:

• Makes families feel heard, understood, and supported

• Develops trust quickly

• Identifies the family’s needs, concerns, and priorities

• Clearly communicates how our services can help

• Moves qualified families toward a Care Consultation

• Follows up consistently and on time

• Maintains an accurate and organized lead pipeline

• Knows exactly where every active inquiry stands

• Continues appropriate follow-up until there is a clear outcome

• Ensures that no family and no opportunity falls through the cracks

The Person We’re Looking For

An inquiry about home care is rarely just a sales lead.

Behind every inquiry is usually a family trying to solve a real problem.

A daughter may be worried about her mother living alone. A spouse may be exhausted from providing care. A family may live out of state and be struggling to figure out how to keep a parent safe at home.

The right person will genuinely want to help these families.

At the same time, helping families means providing direction.

We are looking for someone who can combine empathy, organization, persistence, and consultative sales skills to guide families toward the right next step.

You should be compassionate enough to listen, confident enough to lead the conversation, and disciplined enough to make sure every family receives the follow-up they were promised.

To Be Considered

Please submit:

• Your current resume

• A brief introduction video telling us about your experience working with prospective clients, customers, patients, or families

In your video, please also tell us:

• About your experience with Salesforce and WellSky

• How you manage follow-up when someone is interested but not yet ready to make a decision

• How you would approach a family member who is overwhelmed and unsure whether home care is the right solution

I’d use this version over the original because it still makes conversion and accountability explicit, but the candidate profile now feels much more aligned with the emotional reality of home care.

• Experience with Instagram,

• **Up to $4,750 USD in monthly performance bonuses.**

• **Total monthly earning potential of up to $5,350 USD under the initial compensation structure.**

• 13th-month pay.

• Opportunities for salary increases and career progression.

The more successful you are at growing our marketing operations, the more you can earn.



**The initial compensation structure is not a permanent ceiling on your earning potential.**



As the business grows, your compensation, responsibilities and earning opportunities can be reviewed.



📈 **LONG-TERM CAREER OPPORTUNITY**



This is more than just another digital marketing position.



We have significant ambitions for the future of OnlyRockets, and we're looking for someone who wants to be an important part of that journey.



For the right person who consistently demonstrates strong performance, leadership, initiative and commitment, there is the potential to progress into a senior leadership position, with only the company owner above you.

• Recruit and develop your own team.

• Introduce and oversee new marketing divisions.

• Take greater ownership of company-wide marketing strategy.

• Progress into a Head of Marketing or Marketing Director position.

• Increase your earnings substantially as the business grows.

🧠 **THE MINDSET WE'RE LOOKING FOR**



We want someone who identifies problems and develops solutions.



Someone who independently researches new opportunities and brings ideas to the business.



Someone who takes responsibility for results, rather than simply completing assigned tasks.



We are recruiting an experienced marketing professional because we want you to bring your own knowledge, expertise and ideas into OnlyRockets.

title: Executive Assistant (Procurement & Bids)
description:
Job summary:

Be the CEO's right hand on public-sector bids. Own every deadline, document and submission, and use Claude to keep it all on track.



Meet Mosaic Effect:

Mosaic Effect is an expert-led privacy, cybersecurity and AI governance consultancy. We win most of our work through public-sector procurement: federal, provincial, municipal and broader-public-sector tenders, supply arrangements, vendor rosters, and contract roles placed through staffing agencies.



The machinery is already built: daily portal and
 sweeps, one opportunity tracker, a stage-gated proposal process, templates, and a submission guide for every portal we use.



The role:

You are the CEO's executive assistant for everything procurement. You own the calendar and the paperwork: no deadline missed, every addendum read the day it posts, every submission in early, complete and on the record.

You take instructions and carry them through precisely. You don't write the technical substance of proposals; the CEO and our consultants do that. You make sure it comes together, gets checked and goes in on time.

You report directly to Sukhpreet Singh, CEO, and work with our consultants, staffing agencies and public-sector buyers.



Who this is for

• You follow instructions to the letter, and you ask when something is unclear instead of guessing.

• You can hold a dozen close dates in your head and never drop one.

• You read the fine print in a solicitation before anyone asks you to.

• You'd rather be done two days early than submit at the last minute.

• You already use Claude or similar AI tools every day, and you always check their work.

• You keep confidential information confidential.



What we expect from you

The work follows each bid from first sighting to final debrief.



1. Find and log opportunities (daily and weekly)

    ◦ Run the daily procurement digest (portal scrapes, bid-notice
s, agency requisitions) and log what's new in the opportunity tracker.

    ◦ Run the weekly procurement pulse across federal, provincial, municipal and broader-public-sector sources for privacy, cybersecurity and AI-consulting work.

    ◦ Coordinate the portal assistant's weekday sweeps of login-only portals. A portal nobody reached is logged as "not checked", never "nothing found".

    ◦ Track signals that aren't bids yet: job postings that could become contracts, upcoming vendor rosters, contract-award intelligence from access-to-information requests, and loss debriefs.



2. Qualify and plan

    ◦ Prepare a one-page bid brief and a compliance matrix for each opportunity: mandatory requirements, scoring, insurance, security, certifications, references and submission method.

    ◦ Flag hard blockers early (insurance limits, WSIB, ISO 27001, clearances, certifications, vehicle-holder-only eligibility) and bring each to the CEO as a go/no-go decision.

    ◦ Build each bid's timeline backward from the close and hold the T-48-hour tripwire: everything is complete two days before close, or the CEO hears about it that day.



3. Run bid production

    ◦ Set up the bid folder from templates and keep documents versioned (v0.x drafts, v1.0 approved).

    ◦ Collect inputs on time: consultant résumés and consents, references and referee consent, corporate documents, insurance certificates, signatures and forms.

    ◦ Run the completeness check against the compliance matrix before review, and track feedback through the green-light gates.

    ◦ Send buyer questions within the question period once the CEO approves them. Download every addendum and Q&A the day it posts and update the matrix.



4. Submit and keep records

    ◦ Assemble the final package and, after CEO approval, submit through the correct portal or by
 at least 24 hours before close.

    ◦ Save proof of submission (receipts, confirmation numbers, screenshots) and file the submitted set.

    ◦ Track outcomes, request a debrief on every loss and log the lessons.



5. Agencies, rosters and registrations

    ◦ Manage staffing-agency requisitions: right-to-represent forms, résumé versions and availability confirmations, with a strict one-person, one-channel rule per requisition.

    ◦ Maintain vendor registrations and portal accounts: CanadaBuys/SAP Business Network, MERX, Bonfire, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, BC Bid, Alberta Purchasing Connection, SaskTenders, Biddingo, bids&tenders and others. Track renewal dates, document fees and supplier profiles.

    ◦ Keep corporate compliance documents current and ready to attach: certificate of status, insurance certificates, WSIB/WorkSafeBC, security clearance records and supplier numbers.



6. Report

    ◦ Keep the opportunity tracker current every day: stage, close date, next action and owner.

    ◦ Send the CEO a short daily status: what closes in the next 14 days, what's blocked and what needs a decision.

    ◦ Keep an accurate work log. If it isn't logged, it didn't happen.



Working with AI and Claude

AI runs a large part of our daily machinery, and Claude is the main tool you'll work with. You direct it, check it and own the result.

• Use Claude to summarize solicitations, draft compliance matrices and bid briefs, and spot mandatory requirements.

• Use Claude to draft buyer and agency
s, daily status notes and tracker updates for the CEO's approval.

• Run and supervise the AI-assisted daily digest and portal sweeps, and confirm each source was actually checked.

• Check every AI output against the source documents before it's used. AI drafts; you verify.

• Give clear, specific instructions to Claude, and improve the prompts and checklists the team relies on.



Requirements

• Exceptional organization and deadline discipline across many parallel close dates.

• Careful reading of solicitation documents: mandatory requirements, evaluation criteria, forms, and insurance and security clauses.

• Strong Word and Excel skills: tracked changes, document assembly, PDF packaging and trackers.

• Clear, concise written English for drafting
s to buyers and agencies.

• Daily, hands-on use of Claude or similar AI tools, with the habit of checking their output.

• Discretion with confidential commercial information.

• Can work EST Timezone.



Nice to have

• 2+ years in executive assistance, bid or proposal coordination, procurement administration or contract administration, ideally with Canadian public-sector tenders.

• Hands-on use of Canadian procurement portals such as CanadaBuys/SAP Business Network, MERX, Bonfire, Ariba, Jaggaer or BC Bid.

• Familiarity with federal supply arrangements and methods of supply (TBIPS, TSPS, SBIPS, ProServices), standing offers and vendor-of-record arrangements.

• Exposure to privacy, cybersecurity or IT consulting procurement.

• Experience with staffing-agency requisitions and right-to-represent processes.



Results

• Zero missed deadlines and zero late or incomplete submissions.

• Every addendum and Q&A downloaded and reflected in the bid within one business day of posting.

• A go/no-go decision on every live opportunity within two business days of intake.

• Every submission in at least 24 hours early, with proof on file.

• A tracker that's accurate at any moment, with no "unknown" status older than a week.

• A debrief requested on every loss.



How we work

• The CEO approves anything that leaves the company: submissions, prices, signatures, declarations, and
s to buyers or agencies. You prepare each one so it only needs a yes.

• Portal logins live in a password manager. Credentials are never shared by
 or stored in documents.

• Everything lives in one shared folder, one tracker and one log.

title: Video Editor
description:
JustSimply Marketing (JSM) is a fast-scaling, fully remote marketing agency based in Ontario, Canada. We help US and Canadian personal brands grow and monetize, from content and video to launches for info products and high-ticket programs. We've worked with Danny Singson, Dr. Nae and Shaun T.



TEAM VISION

YouTube is where our clients build trust at scale and where viewers turn into buyers. The video team exists to make every upload hold attention. Editors who drive results grow with the team under the Video Editor Manager.



THE ROLE

You own the edit on our clients' YouTube channels: 8-20 minute long-form videos plus the Shorts that feed them. You shape raw footage into stories that keep viewers watching, using pacing, visuals, subtitles and sound design to protect retention from the first second to the end screen.



You report to the Video Editor Manager. You work with scriptwriters, thumbnail designers, short-form editors and the Social Media team. You are judged on retention, watch time and CTR, not on polish for its own sake.



WHO THIS IS FOR

You open YouTube Studio before you open your inbox.

You know where viewers drop off and you cut to stop it.

You follow algorithm changes because they change how you edit.

You want to grow your craft on channels that matter.

This is not for you if you want to polish for weeks, wait for perfect direction, or avoid feedback on your numbers.



WHAT WE OFFER YOU

Full-time, fully remote work, open worldwide, with flexible hours.

Edit for high-profile personal brands like Danny Singson, Dr. Nae and Shaun T.

A growth path inside the video team as you prove results.

Fast decisions and zero bureaucracy.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

title: B2B Appointment Setter & Growth Assistant (UK Market) – Full-Time, PH Evening Shift – $1,200–1,500/mo + bonus
description:
Ambergaard is a long-term business partner for owners of staffing agencies. I work personally with the owner and their team, and my developers build the revenue systems and improvements that take an agency's net profit to a multiple of where it is today. I am hiring a full-time employee to call the owners and CEOs of UK staffing agencies, book their first 30-minute call with me, and help build the company around that.



WHO WE ARE



My name is Rolands. I have been in the staffing business for more than eight years. I built agencies in Latvia and Denmark, and in that time my teams placed over 1,600 workers and generated over €40 million in turnover. I started Ambergaard to do for other agency owners what I did for my own: win better clients, fill jobs faster and keep the margin.



We are a small specialty company, not a call centre. There are no departments to hand things to. The people who join now will shape how we work, and they will be the first people I rely on when the business grows.



THE ROLE



Your main job is booking meetings:



- You call owners, CEOs and managing directors of UK staffing agencies from a prepared list.

- You get past the gatekeeper, speak with the owner as one business person to another, answer the objections, and book a 30-minute online call with me.

- Outside the calling windows, you research the companies on your list before you call them, send follow-up
s and LinkedIn messages, and confirm every booked meeting the day before so that it actually takes place.

- You log every call in Pipedrive on the same day: the outcome, your notes and the next step. Keeping the data tidy is a requirement of the role.

- All calls are recorded for quality reasons.

- You tell me what you hear on the calls, and we improve the script together.



Your second job is helping the business grow. In a company this size that means practically anything that is needed: preparing notes and materials before my meetings, cleaning and building prospect lists, keeping the CRM in order, testing new tools we want to use, handling follow-ups after a meeting, and tasks we have not thought of yet. If you want a narrowly defined job where nothing changes, this is not it. If you want to be part of building something and grow with it, it is.



You get a script and paid training, and you need to understand what we do well enough to argue for it in your own words.



SCHEDULE (Philippine time)



Monday to Friday, 5:00 PM – 1:30 AM Manila time (UK 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM), with a 30-minute unpaid break, so 8 paid hours a day and 40 a week. Calls start no earlier than 9:30 AM UK time. The calling windows are 5:30 PM – 7:00 PM and 9:00 PM – 12:00 midnight Manila time (UK 9:30 – 11:00 AM and 1:00 – 4:00 PM); the time before, between and after them is for research, follow-ups, CRM work and the support tasks above, and you take your break in the gap between the two windows. During UK summer time (late March to late October) everything moves one hour earlier: 4:00 PM – 12:30 AM, calling from 4:30 PM. This is an evening shift, not a graveyard shift.



PAY



- $1,200 – $1,500 USD per month for 40 hours a week, depending on your experience.

- $30 bonus for every meeting you book that actually takes place.

- 13th month pay after 12 months with us.

- Paid twice a month, on time, by bank transfer.

- A paid 10-hour trial to start, then paid training on our service, the staffing industry, the script and the objections.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent. You are comfortable talking to British business owners as an equal.

- Previous B2B cold-calling or sales experience speaking with decision-makers. Customer service experience alone is not enough.

- Strong argumentation. You can hold a conversation when the owner pushes back.

- Organised and self-directed. You can take a loosely defined task, figure out what is needed and finish it without being chased.

- A quiet room for every call, your own computer, a good headset and stable internet (a backup connection is a plus).

- You will work in Pipedrive every day and keep the data tidy. Experience with Pipedrive or a similar CRM helps.

- You are registered, or willing to register, as self-employed with the BIR and can issue monthly invoices.

- Availability for the long term. If you are looking for a few weeks of work, this is not the right role.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



The call list, the script, Pipedrive, calling software with a UK number, and training.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your message with the word STAFFING so I know you read the whole post.

2. Add a link to a video of up to 2 minutes (Loom, Google Drive or unlisted YouTube). Introduce yourself in a few sentences. One take on a phone or laptop camera is enough.

3. Describe your most relevant B2B calling work: who you called, what you sold, and your results in numbers.



Applications without the video will not be considered.

This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, follows up consistently, and keeps financial information accurate and organized. You will work closely with company leadership, team members in the United States and abroad, and our external accountant.



## Key Responsibilities



### Bookkeeping and Financial Records



- Maintain accurate and organized records in QuickBooks.

- Categorize and reconcile transactions, accounts, and payments.

- Keep financial information current and identify discrepancies promptly.

- Prepare regular reports that give management a clear view of the company’s financial position.

- Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions.



### JobNimbus and Invoicing



- Maintain the financial side of our JobNimbus CRM.

- Confirm that customer invoices are accurate, complete, and issued on time.

- Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue balances.

- Record payments and keep customer account information current.

- Assess applicable late fees according to company policies.

- Perform other collection-related activities to help ensure timely payment.

- Reconcile financial information between JobNimbus and QuickBooks.



### Weekly Payroll



- Verify hours submitted by team members in the United States and abroad.

- Identify missing, inaccurate, or unusual time entries before payroll is processed.

- Prepare and coordinate weekly payroll for U.S.-based and international team members.

- Maintain accurate payroll records and resolve payroll discrepancies.

- Protect confidential employee and payroll information.



### Commissions and Spreadsheets



- Maintain spreadsheets used to calculate commissions and other team compensation.

- Verify commission amounts against completed jobs, collected payments, and company policies.

- Provide accurate commission reports before payments are approved.

- Maintain organized and auditable spreadsheet records.



### Accountant Coordination



- Coordinate with our external accountant regarding filings and financial reporting.

- Provide requested records and supporting documents accurately and on time.

- Help ensure the accountant has the information needed for tax filings, compliance, and year-end reporting.

- Respond promptly to questions and resolve missing-information requests.



### General Financial Administration



- Manage other financial and bookkeeping responsibilities as needed.

- Improve financial processes and help maintain strong internal controls.

- Communicate financial concerns, overdue accounts, and discrepancies to management.

- Meet recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual deadlines.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous bookkeeping or accounting experience.

- Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online.

- Experience processing or coordinating payroll.

- Strong spreadsheet skills, including Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Experience with invoicing, accounts receivable, and collections.

- High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy.

- Excellent organization, time-management, and follow-up skills.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to handle confidential financial and payroll information professionally.

- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, and a quiet workspace.

- Ability to work independently and communicate proactively with a remote team.

- Willingness to work the required U.S. business hours and occasional additional hours when needed.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience using JobNimbus or a similar home-services CRM.

- Bookkeeping experience with a U.S.-based company.

- Experience in roofing, construction, contracting, or another home-services industry.

- Familiarity with U.S. payroll and basic accounting practices.

- Experience calculating sales commissions or performance-based compensation.

- Experience working directly with an external accountant or CPA.



## What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will:



- Keep QuickBooks and JobNimbus accurate and up to date.

- Ensure weekly payroll is prepared correctly and on time.

- Make sure invoices are issued promptly and actively followed up until collected.

- Maintain accurate commission calculations and supporting records.

- Give management timely visibility into financial issues.

- Provide complete, organized information to our accountant.

- Take ownership of financial tasks without requiring constant reminders.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your résumé or CV.

2. A brief description of your bookkeeping experience.

3. Details about your experience with QuickBooks, payroll, invoicing, collections, and spreadsheets.

title: Google Ads Account Manager (MCC) – Remote
description:
Google Ads Account Manager (MCC) – Remote

Job Title: Google Ads Account Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote

Working Schedule: Monday – Friday

Working Hours: 40 hours per week

Monthly Salary: USD 1,200–1,800 (Negotiable based on experience and qualifications)

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Google Ads Account Manager to manage, monitor, and optimize multiple advertising accounts through Google Ads Manager Accounts (MCC).



The ideal candidate should have practical experience managing Google Ads campaigns, analyzing performance data, developing effective advertising strategies, and improving campaign results.



This position is suitable for someone with strong analytical skills, a good understanding of digital advertising, and the ability to manage multiple accounts independently in a remote working environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage and monitor multiple Google Ads accounts through Google Ads Manager Accounts (MCC).

- Create, structure, and optimize Search, Display, and Performance Max campaigns.

- Monitor key performance indicators, including CPC, CTR, CPA, conversion rates, and ROAS.

- Analyze campaign data and identify opportunities to improve advertising performance.

- Manage campaign budgets and ensure efficient allocation of advertising spend.

- Develop and implement optimization strategies based on campaign performance.

- Prepare regular performance reports and provide actionable recommendations.

- Identify and troubleshoot campaign issues when necessary.

- Keep up to date with Google Ads features, policies, and industry best practices.

Requirements

- Proven experience managing Google Ads campaigns professionally.

- Hands-on experience using Google Ads Manager Accounts (MCC).

- Good understanding of Search Ads, Display Ads, and Performance Max campaigns.

- Knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager.

- Understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, and campaign measurement.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Good written communication skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple advertising accounts and prioritize tasks effectively.

- Ability to work independently and communicate effectively in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing multiple Google Ads accounts simultaneously.

- Demonstrated experience improving campaign performance and advertising efficiency.

- Familiarity with conversion tracking and performance reporting tools.

- Experience managing advertising budgets across different industries.

- Google Ads certifications are an advantage but not mandatory.

Campaign Portfolio & Previous Results

As part of your application, we would appreciate it if you could share examples of Google Ads campaigns you have previously managed or successfully optimized.



Please include the following information where available:

- Examples of your best-performing Google Ads campaigns.

- Campaign objectives and advertising strategies.

- Your role and specific responsibilities in managing each campaign.

- Optimization methods and improvements you implemented.

- Measurable results, such as ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC, and conversion rates.

Portfolio Privacy Notice:



Please ensure that all confidential or sensitive information is removed or properly concealed before submitting your portfolio.



Do not disclose client names, company identities, account IDs, login credentials, personal information, or proprietary business data without proper authorization.



Screenshots, performance reports, and case studies are welcome, provided that they do not reveal confidential information.



If you are unable to share original campaign materials, you may provide anonymized examples or a written summary of your previous results.

What We Offer

- Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and qualifications.

- Fully remote working arrangement.

- Full-time, Monday-to-Friday schedule.

- Stable, long-term professional opportunity.

- Collaborative and supportive working environment.

- Opportunities for professional development and skill improvement.

How to Apply

If you have relevant experience managing Google Ads accounts through MCC and believe you are a good fit for this position, we invite you to submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph.



Please include:

1. A brief introduction and summary of your Google Ads experience.

2. Your experience managing Google Ads MCC accounts.

3. The types of campaigns and industries you have worked with.

4. Examples of previous campaigns or an anonymized portfolio demonstrating your results.

5. Your expected monthly salary.

Please make sure your portfolio does not contain confidential client or account information.



We appreciate your interest and look forward to learning more about your experience!

I’m looking for someone to work with me full-time, learn my editing style and turn those recordings into Instagram Reels, Stories & TikTok's that still sound like me.



We’ll work closely together at the start. I’ll share a raw recording and its finished Reel, show you exactly how I edit in the Captions app, and talk through why I kept one take and cut another. We’ll review your first edits together. Once you’re confident with the style, you’ll manage each batch from raw footage through to scheduled posts.

What you’ll do



- Edit short videos. A typical edit starts with around three minutes of me talking to camera and finishes as a Reel of roughly 60 seconds. You’ll cut mistakes, repeated takes and unnecessary gaps while keeping the story easy to follow.



- Get the captions right. Apply my chosen subtitle style, position the text near the bottom so it stays clear of my face, and listen back to check the wording. Occasionally, you’ll add a photo or cutaway to show what I’m talking about. You’ll watch every finished video before sending it for review.



- Publish through Buffer to post to
, Into & TikTok. Schedule approved content and check that it goes live as planned.



- Help me d
 what to film next. Look at the questions people ask and which posts start conversations. Bring me specific ideas with an opening line I can use when I sit down to record.





Who I’m looking for

This isn't a traditional virtual assistant position. We're looking for someone who thinks like an entrepreneur, takes initiative, and enjoys figuring out how to grow a small business.

 through cost-effective marketing strategies.

We care about:

2. Improving non-branded organic search visibility.

**, spend 10–15 minutes reviewing the website, and answer these three questions:

title: PROJECT COORDINATOR
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a proactive, highly organized, and resourceful Project Coordinator to join our growing team!



You will work closely with our Program Manager and cross-functional teams to coordinate strategic business initiatives, manage project timelines, track deliverables, and ensure projects move forward efficiently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

title: Aspire Systems & Operations Coordinator
description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a detail-oriented, self-motivated Aspire CRM Specialist to support our established property management, landscaping, and home maintenance business. This part-time remote role offers the opportunity to work directly with the business owner and collaborate with office staff and division leaders to improve how work moves through Aspire from service documentation and work tickets to billing preparation and reporting.



The business implemented Aspire in 2026 and is seeking a capable professional to help strengthen its use across multiple service divisions. Initial priorities include reviewing outstanding records and work tickets, resolving administrative backlogs, and developing consistent, practical workflows.



This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing order to a busy operation, taking ownership of defined priorities, and seeing the impact of their work.



Key Responsibilities:

- Provide general administrative support to the business owner, helping manage day-to-day operational needs.

Assess existing Aspire records and workflows with the business owner and team, then establish clear priorities for cleanup and improvement.

- Review outstanding work tickets and incomplete records, identify missing information, and coordinate follow-up to help move completed work toward accurate, timely billing.

- Improve the accuracy and consistency of customer, property, service, and job information across multiple divisions.

- Help establish repeatable processes for recurring services, service documentation, and administrative follow-through.

- Document agreed-upon workflows in clear, practical procedures that team members can follow consistently.

- Provide concise progress updates, flag decisions requiring input, and recommend practical solutions to recurring administrative problems.

- Maintain and organize business information using Aspire and Google Sheets.

- Support the coordination and organization of multiple accounts and projects simultaneously.

- Identify administrative challenges, apply critical thinking, and independently work toward practical solutions.

- Collaborate with the business owner and other team members as needed.

- Maintain accuracy, organization, and consistency across assigned administrative responsibilities.



Schedule: Part-time, 20+ hours per week, with flexible scheduling during regular business hours. The client's standard operating hours are 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time. No weekend or evening availability is required.



Compensation:

Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and role scope.



Monthly compensation ranges from ₱33,000 – ₱43,000, depending on experience and role scope. Final compensation is aligned with the candidate's experience level.



Required Skills:

Core Technical Skills Required:

- Aspire CRM: Hands-on experience managing work tickets, maintaining accurate records, and supporting service workflows and billing preparation in Aspire. Ability to investigate workflow issues, identify gaps, and coordinate solutions with the team. Implementation or system configuration experience is a plus.

- Google Sheets: Proficiency in organizing, maintaining, and managing business information using spreadsheets.

- Administrative Support: Experience providing general administrative assistance to business owners in the home services industry.

- Industry Knowledge: 2+ years of relevant experience, including familiarity with landscaping, grounds maintenance, or property management operations.

- Multi-Project Administration: Ability to manage administrative responsibilities across multiple accounts or projects.



Professional Skills Required:

- Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, with the initiative to work independently without constant supervision.

- Native or near-native English fluency, effective team collaboration, and the ability to communicate clearly with business owners and colleagues.



Candidate Fit:

- A self-motivated professional who understands Aspire CRM and can contribute effectively without extensive hands-on guidance.

- A resourceful problem-solver who takes ownership of administrative challenges and actively looks for solutions.

- An organized individual comfortable balancing multiple responsibilities while collaborating with a small operational team.



Professional Readiness:

Candidates applying for this role should have a reliable home office setup, stable internet connection, and the ability to maintain consistent availability during the required working hours.



Successful candidates communicate proactively, meet deadlines, and take ownership of responsibilities while working remotely.



Application Process:

If you meet the requirements outlined above and are interested in this opportunity, please provide your resume and submitting a short 1-minute introduction video.



In your video briefly share:

- Your professional background

- The types of work you specialize in

- Why this opportunity interests you



We will review applications and contact qualified candidates regarding next steps.

title: Office Coordinator / Scheduler
description:
IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT A RECRUITMENT ROLE — WE ARE NOT HIRING RECRUITERS.



Office Coordinator / Scheduler 



SLB In-Home Care — pediatric in-home nursing (Georgia, USA) · Remote (Philippines-based)

Work setup: Remote · Full-time, long-term · Must work U.S. Eastern business hours (families & nurses are in Georgia)



Pay: $800 - $1,120 / month (equivalent to ~$5–$7/hour at ~160 hours/month), depending on experience



Reports to: Owners · works daily with the nurses, recruiter, and families



About the role:

SLB In-Home Care provides skilled nursing and personal-care support to medically fragile children across Georgia. We're

looking for a sharp, dependable Scheduler / Office Coordinator to run our day-to-day scheduling and family/nurse

communication desk.

You'll work alongside our automation — the system prepares the schedules, flags the changes, logs the calls, and builds

the tickets. Your job is the human side: review and confirm what the system prepares, make the calls, keep families and

nurses in the loop, and stay on top of the moving pieces so nothing falls through the cracks.



What you'll do:



* Scheduling: maintain the weekly nurse/caregiver schedules; review and commit schedule changes the system drafts;

keep the calendar accurate.



* Supervisory visits: schedule required nurse supervisory (SV) visits on cadence and send the reminders.



* Calls & texts: handle inbound and outbound calls and texts with families and nurses — return missed calls promptly,

confirm appointments, answer scheduling questions.



* Ticketing: own the request queue — log every family/nurse request, follow up, and close it out.



* Timesheet coordination: chase missing shift notes and timesheets and flag discrepancies (the system helps surface

these).



* Documentation: keep everything organized and up to date in our systems (CareBravo, ClickUp).



!!! Important — this is a phone-heavy, English-first role. You'll be talking to American families and nurses every day. Excellent

spoken and written English is required and will be tested in the interview. Dependability during U.S. Eastern hours is non-

negotiable.



Requirements:



Must have:

*Excellent spoken and written English — clear, warm, professional on the phone

*Strong organization and attention to detail; able to juggle many moving pieces without dropping any

*Reliable and available during U.S. Eastern business hours

*Comfortable working alongside software/AI — reviewing and confirming what the system prepares, not fighting it

*Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset



Nice to have:

*Home-care, home-health, or medical scheduling experience

*Experience with scheduling / EVV software (CareBravo, or similar)





Bonus:

*Experience working with a U.S. company or in U.S. healthcare / Medicaid

*Customer-service or call-center background

*Experience with ClickUp or a similar ticketing / task tool







How to apply:

Please send your résumé and a short voice recording or Loom video introducing yourself (so we can hear your English),

plus brief answers to:

1. Describe your scheduling or coordination experience.

2. Do you have any home-care, healthcare, or U.S.-company experience?

3. What tools have you used — scheduling software, EVV, ClickUp, ticketing?

4. Tell us about a time you managed a lot of moving pieces or last-minute changes. How did you stay on top of it?

5. Your available hours in U.S. Eastern time, and your internet speed.





!!!! Only candidates with strong English and real coordination experience will be considered. This is a long-term role with room

to grow into an operations lead.

description:

- Edit a high volume of short vertical reels every month from raw talking-head footage and B-roll.

- Build custom animated text and title hooks, not just default captions.

- Add motion graphics, transitions, and animation that fit the video.

title: E-commerce Shopify Google Dropshipping Customer Support Specialist
description:
We’re hiring an experienced Customer Support Specialist to join our existing support team and take ownership of
 support for our growing Shopify dropshipping store. Hands-on customer support experience with Shopify dropshipping stores is required. Experience supporting stores that use Google Ads as a main acquisition channel is strongly preferred.



We’re looking for an A-player who stays organised when order volume spikes, makes good decisions under pressure, and follows through. When we explain a recurring task once, we expect you to build it into your routine and handle it without reminders. If a supplier owes you an update, you follow up, keep the customer informed, and see the case through to resolution.

What you’ll do

- Manage
 support in Re:amaze, covering orders, tracking, sizing, returns, and refunds.

- Investigate delayed, lost, damaged, or incorrect orders. Coordinate with suppliers and fulfilment partners, and process refunds, replacements, or order changes in Shopify within our policies.

- Keep track of urgent tickets, promised updates, and cases waiting on a supplier, even on busy days.

- Work closely with teammates. Share important updates, flag blockers early, and leave clear notes so someone else can pick up a case without asking the customer to repeat themselves.

- Spot recurring issues by product, size, or supplier and propose a fix, such as correcting a listing, updating a sizing guide, or escalating a fulfilment issue.

What we’re looking for

- Strong Shopify dropshipping experience and excellent written English.

- Clear communication with both customers and teammates. You keep people informed and give them the context they need to act.

- Good judgement when a case falls outside the usual SOP. You can investigate what happened, propose a solution, and recognise when to escalate.

- Practical AI skills. You can use AI to draft replies, summarise long threads, and spot patterns across tickets. You verify order details and check the relevant policy before replying to a customer.

- Previous team lead or senior support experience is a plus, especially if you’ve handled escalations, reviewed ticket quality, or improved a support process. This is a hands-on specialist role.



You’ll start part-time during onboarding. We expect the role to grow to full-time soon, depending on ticket volume and how quickly you can handle cases independently. Starting pay is $4 USD per hour, with room for raises as you gain experience with our stores and take on more responsibility.



To apply, please start with your:

Full name

Years of Shopify dropshipping customer support experience

Country you’re based in

title: Documentation Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time Process Documentation Specialist to capture, write, and maintain clear documentation of our business processes, starting with how our team works in NetSuite.



This role will lead the effort to document how our business operates using NetSuite, both internally and externally with customers.  You will map out how records, transactions, and reports move through the system and who is responsible at each step. As NetSuite documentation is completed, the scope will broaden to other departments and processes across the company.



You will work closely with our accounting/finance, operations, and NetSuite users to interview process owners, observe how work is actually done, and turn it into standard operating procedures (SOPs), process maps, and guides that anyone on the team can follow. You should be adept at identifying unclear processes and leveraging team leaders to clarify current and future state.





Key Responsibilities



Process discovery

Meet with process owners and end users to understand how current processes are performed, step by step

Review existing NetSuite setup, including saved searches, workflows, forms, and reports, to understand how processes run in the system

Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and undocumented workarounds, and flag them to leadership

Prioritize documentation work with leadership based on business impact and risk



NetSuite process documentation

Write step-by-step SOPs and user guides for key NetSuite processes such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, and month-end close

Create process flow diagrams and swimlane maps showing roles, handoffs, approvals, and system touchpoints

Capture screenshots and short screen recordings to support written instructions

Document NetSuite roles, permissions, custom fields, saved searches, and workflows in plain language

Coordinate with our NetSuite resources to document new configurations, reports, and changes as they are released



Documentation management and expansion

Build and maintain a central, organized documentation library with consistent templates, naming, and version control

Review drafts with process owners and update documents as feedback comes in and processes change

Develop training materials, quick reference guides, and checklists for new and existing staff

Extend documentation efforts to other departments, systems, and processes as priorities shift

Provide regular status updates on documentation progress to leadership





Qualifications



Required

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field

3+ years of experience in process documentation, technical writing, or business analysis

Working knowledge of NetSuite or a comparable ERP system

Proven ability to write clear, concise SOPs, work instructions, and user guides for non-technical audiences

Experience creating process maps and flowcharts using tools such as Visio, L
, or Miro

Understanding of core business processes such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, and financial close

Strong interviewing and listening skills to draw out how work is actually done

Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills

Lead rather than being led:  Ability to lead meetings and discussions, proactively lead the team on how to conduct the process mapping, discovery and review

Ability to work independently, manage multiple documents at once, and meet deadlines

Clear communicator who can work with both technical and non-technical users



Preferred

Direct experience documenting NetSuite processes, configurations, or implementations

Familiarity with NetSuite saved searches, workflows, roles, and custom records

Experience with screen capture and recording tools such as Snagit, Scribe, or Loom

Experience building knowledge bases in tools such as Confluence, SharePoint, Notion, or Google Workspace

Exposure to process improvement methods (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, or BPMN)

Background in accounting, finance, or operations



Work Environment

Full-time, remote, independent contractor status

Align to the organization’s Central time zone hours (8 AM - 5 PM CST) 8 hours per day, Monday through Friday

Candidate must agree to hold this role exclusively, with no other projects or clients, and that no sub-contracting of work will occur.

Candidate must provide their own personal laptop and at least one additional monitor that will be your exclusive work laptop (not used or shared by others).

Candidate must provide a backup device in case of a laptop or equipment failure.

Candidate must have a backup power supply in case of power outage to ensure work continuity.

Candidate must provide a backup internet connection (such as a secondary ISP or mobile hotspot) in case of an outage to ensure work continuity. 





Compensation & Benefits

Competitive independent contractor pay commensurate with experience 

US Holiday pay

title: Care Specialist
description:

Interviews will be scheduled for this Friday Pacific Time.



We're a fast-moving healthcare operations team that handles prior authorizations (PAs) for infusion clinic. We're building a team of sharp, hungry operators to help us do it at scale.



As a Care Specialist, you'll be on the front lines — initiating PA requests, verifying insurance benefits, navigating payer portals and phone systems, and documenting cases accurately in our internal platform. You'll work directly with our team leads and report into operations leadership.



Warning: this is not an easy job. The learning curve is steep and the pace is fast— every case you touch is a patient waiting on treatment. We'll train you on the content, but we can't train work ethic, attention to detail, or the drive to push through hard problems. If you want comfortable, this isn't it. If you want growth, you’ll fit right in.



What You'll Do

Initiate prior authorization requests with insurance payers via online portals and phone calls

Accurately document case details, call notes, and outcomes in our internal case management platform

Navigate complex payer phone trees and hold times without losing steam

Identify when cases hit non-standard situations and escalate or problem-solve proactively

Follow SOPs closely while flagging gaps or process improvement opportunities

Manage a live queue of cases across multiple statuses — nothing falls through the cracks



You're a Great Fit If You Are...

Hungry and self-driven

You don't wait to be told what to do next — you find the next task

You want to grow fast and take on more responsibility over time



Obsessively detail-oriented

You catch errors others miss - wrong codes, missing fields, inconsistent info

You don't submit work you're not sure about

You understand that one mistake in a PA form can delay a patient's treatment by weeks



A fast, independent learner

You can read a new SOP and execute it correctly within a few days

You ask smart clarifying questions before going down the wrong path

You're comfortable not knowing everything on day one and excited to learn



A creative problem-solver

When a case hits an edge case, you think before you escalate

You come to your manager with a proposed solution, not just a problem

You document what happened so the next person doesn't hit the same wall



Resilient and relentless

Hold times, rejections, and ambiguous situations don't demoralize you

You stay focused through repetitive tasks without cutting corners

Requirements

Strong written and spoken English - you'll communicate with US insurance reps and clinic staff

Comfortable working US business hours (EST or PST overlap required)

Tech-comfortable — you can navigate multiple browser tabs, portals, and spreadsheets simultaneously

Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment

What You Don't Need

A medical or clinical background — we'll teach you what you need to know about PAs and insurance. You just need to be a fast learner.

Years of experience — we care far more about how you think and how hard you work



What We Offer

Above-market starting pay — we pay more than most entry-level BPO or VA roles because we expect more

Performance bonuses — hit your targets, earn more. Hustle is rewarded directly

Formal 4-month review — we evaluate and adjust compensation fast, not on a yearly corporate clock

Solid career growth path — PA Agent ? Senior PA Agent ? Team Lead. We promote from within and we're growing very fast

Ground-floor opportunity — you're joining early. The people who build with us now are the ones who lead later

Fully Remote

The ideal candidate is persistent, organized, coachable, and excited to learn a complex industry quickly.



As you demonstrate consistency, judgment, and results, there is an opportunity to earn broader responsibility, increased compensation, and deeper ownership of discovery, qualification, and deal progression.



============================================================



ABOUT TOKEN OF TRUST



Token of Trust helps regulated ecommerce businesses keep selling with confidence.



We help merchants launch compliant checkout, verify customers when required, reduce compliance risk, and manage the reporting and evidence they need to operate in regulated markets.



Customers have rated Token of Trust 4.9 stars on G2, and G2 recognized us among the 2026 Top 50 Data Privacy Products. We have also been recognized for Best Support, Easiest To Do Business With, High Performer, and Users Most Likely To Recommend.



We operate on a hybrid Customer-Led Growth and Product-Led Growth model, combining customer insight-driven priorities with self-service product experiences.



Sales helps merchants understand what they need to stay compliant, get found, and keep selling. You will work in an environment that sits at the intersection of ecommerce, compliance, identity verification, trust, and growth.



============================================================



RESPONSIBILITIES



COLD CALLING & OUTBOUND OUTREACH



- Make outbound calls and send prospecting
s to assigned leads, with a minimum of 20 productive outreaches (calls plus
s) per day.

- Start each lead with an
, follow up with a call, and keep following up until you've completed all the planned touches.

- Research each company's website and lead brief before every call so the conversation is relevant from the first sentence.

- Work through front desks and gatekeepers: learn the decision-maker's name, the best time to reach them, and the best way to get a callback.

- Work one list type at a time (ecommerce, brick-and-mortar, or B2B) and use the matching talk track for each.

- Call business lines only for first contact, and follow all do-not-contact and opt-out requests right away.



FOLLOW-UP & PIPELINE MANAGEMENT



- Schedule and complete callbacks on the date the prospect gives you, and keep your follow-up queue current every week.

- Book qualified discovery calls and hand them off with clear notes on the prospect's situation, needs, and timing.

- Run first-pass qualification and pass larger opportunities to the Chief Revenue Officer according to the handoff rules.

- Follow up with existing customers flagged as upgrade or expansion opportunities when assigned.



CRM, CALL LOGGING & FEEDBACK



- Work your leads in Pipedrive: log every call,
, outcome, and next step the same day. No side spreadsheets.

- Record calls in Avoma and log objections with the call link so the team can review and improve the pitch.

- Flag bad or incomplete lead data (wrong phone, broken website, missing contact) with the correct label so the lead-enrichment process can fix it.

- Share what you hear on calls (objections, common questions, missing materials) in daily huddles and weekly reporting.



============================================================



WHAT YOU BRING



CORE REQUIREMENTS



- 1-3 years of experience in sales development, cold calling, inside sales, telesales, or a related outbound role.

- Proven comfort making high volumes of cold calls, getting past gatekeepers, and handling rejection professionally.

- Clear, confident spoken English and strong written communication skills.

- Experience working in a CRM such as Pipedrive, HubSpot, or Salesforce, including logging activities and managing a follow-up queue.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to meet daily activity targets consistently.

- A quiet workspace, reliable internet, and a good headset for calls.

- Ability to work with meaningful overlap during U.S. Central Time business hours.



WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED



- You are persistent and enjoy owning your leads from first touch to booked meeting.

- You research before you dial and can quickly find what matters on a company's website.

- You can explain technical, regulatory, or industry-specific topics in plain, practical language.

- You take coaching well and adjust your pitch based on call reviews and objection data.

- You use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms to speed up research and
 writing.

- Familiarity with B2B SaaS, ecommerce, regulated industries (such as vape, alcohol, or supplements), or calling small business owners is a plus.



============================================================



SCHEDULE



- Remote, full-time independent contractor role.

- 40 hours per week required.

- Meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours is required, since calls happen during U.S. business hours.

- Please include your timezone, preferred working hours, and the amount of overlap you can provide with U.S. business hours in your application.



============================================================



COMPENSATION



Base pay is 487.50–552.50 USD per month.

With commission, you’ll earn 750–850 USD per month when you meet your targets.

Commission is uncapped.



============================================================



HOW TO APPLY



Use this subject line:



TRUST - Sales Development Representative Application



Please send:



1. RESUME OR LINKEDIN PROFILE



- Include a link to your most up-to-date resume or LinkedIn profile.



2. COMPENSATION AND AVAILABILITY



- Confirm that the monthly OTE range and the 65% base / 35% target commission split work for you.

- List your expected monthly OTE in USD.

- Confirm your availability to work 40 hours per week.

- List your timezone.

- List your preferred working hours.

- State the amount of overlap you can provide with U.S. Central Time business hours.

- State your earliest possible start date.



3. COLD CALLING EXPERIENCE



- In 5-8 sentences, describe your cold calling or outbound experience: what you sold, who you called, your typical daily call volume, and your results (meetings booked, conversion rates, or quota attainment).



4. VOICE RECORDING



- Record a 60-90 second cold-call opener as if you were calling the owner of an online store, and include the link. We want to hear your voice, pace, and tone.



5. SHORT WRITTEN EXERCISE



A front-desk employee answers your call and says, "The owner's not in. Just send us an
."



Please answer:



- What would you say next?

- What information would you try to learn before ending the call?

- What would your follow-up
 say?

- How would you log the call and plan your next touch?



6. AI USAGE NOTE



Tell us how you used AI, if at all, to complete this application:



- Which sections did AI help with?

- Where did you rely on your own judgment?

- How did you verify that your final answer reflected your actual experience and thinking?



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be reviewed.



============================================================



HIRING PROCESS



After initial application review, selected candidates may be asked to confirm role requirements, compensation fit, long-term interest, independent-contractor status, no agency or subcontracting relationship, time-tracking expectations, background-check willingness, and integrity expectations.



Finalists may be asked to complete a live role-play call and a paid trial calling shift before final interviews.

title: Google Workspace Administrator | Systems & Workflow Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced Google Workspace Administrator to help set up, organize, and manage Google Workspace as the company's central operating system.



You will be responsible for configuring Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, and Meet, organizing shared drives and user permissions, and creating structured workflows that help the team work more efficiently.



This role goes beyond basic Google Workspace usage. We need someone who has hands-on experience setting up and managing business systems, documenting processes, and connecting tools to improve daily operations.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, technically capable, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of systems setup and ongoing administration.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Set up and configure Google Workspace as the company's central business hub.

- Manage Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Meet.

- Organize shared drives, folders, file structures, and access permissions.

- Create and manage user accounts, groups, and appropriate access levels.

- Establish consistent naming conventions and document organization standards.

- Build and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), templates, and internal documentation.

- Develop and improve workflows to streamline daily business operations.

- Connect and coordinate Google Workspace with other business tools and systems.

- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and better system organization.

- Provide ongoing Google Workspace administration and troubleshooting.

- Train team members on processes, tools, and proper system usage.

- Maintain organized, secure, and accessible company information.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Hands-on experience setting up and administering Google Workspace for a business or organization.

- Strong knowledge of Google Drive, shared drives, folder structures, and access permissions.

- Proficiency in Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.

- Experience managing user accounts and organizing company information.

- Ability to create clear SOPs, process documentation, and workflow instructions.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, troubleshoot issues, and take ownership of assigned projects.

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Experience managing Google Workspace as a company's central operating system.

- Knowledge of Google Apps Script or other workflow automation tools.

- Experience integrating Google Workspace with third-party applications.

- Familiarity with Zapier, Make, or similar automation platforms.

- Previous experience supporting U.S.-based businesses.

- Experience training employees and implementing new internal systems.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



We are looking for someone who understands how to build and maintain organized business systems, not simply someone who knows how to use Google applications.



You should be able to take a disorganized workspace, create a logical structure, establish proper permissions, document processes, and make it easier for an entire team to operate efficiently.



We value initiative, problem-solving, accountability, and the ability to recommend practical improvements.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. Have you personally set up and administered Google Workspace for a company or organization? Briefly describe what you configured and managed.

2. What is your experience organizing Google Shared Drives, managing user permissions, and creating SOPs or business workflows?

3. Have you worked with automation or integration tools such as Google Apps Script, Zapier, or Make? Please describe how you have used them.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



To confirm that you have read the entire job description, please use this exact subject line when applying:



GOOGLE WORKSPACE - [YOUR FULL NAME]



Applications that do not follow the subject-line instruction may not be prioritized.

We need a dedicated Project Manager who understands creative video workflows—someone who brings order, speed, clear systems, and sharp content intuition to keep high-volume media projects moving smoothly from raw capture to final publish.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



End-to-End Project Management: Oversee the full lifecycle of Kipkeh Media video content. Track production pipelines, manage shifting priorities, and enforce delivery deadlines across multiple concurrent projects.

Pre-Edit Asset QA & Creative Briefs: Audit incoming raw video footage before handing off to video editors. Evaluate visual/audio quality, identify high-value promotional hooks, and write clear creative notes on what to cut, keep, or emphasize.



Cross-Functional Team Alignment: Lead daily syncs across field creators (hosts/vloggers), remote intake specialists, and post-production editors to keep all moving parts synchronized and accountable to publishing dates.

SOP & Dashboard Optimization: Maintain clean, real-time tracking systems (Google Workspace, Slack, PM tools) and continuously optimize workflows as our media portfolio grows.

Project Management Expertise (Primary): 2+ years of proven experience as a Project Manager, Operations Coordinator, or Production Lead in a digital media, agency, or video environment.

Creative & Video Intuition: A sharp eye for raw footage evaluation, video story structure, and recognizing engaging commercial hooks for local business promotions.

Agile Problem-Solving: High agency and composure under pressure—you adapt quickly to changing daily production schedules without losing track of details.

Technical Proficiency: Expert-level command of Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs), Slack, and modern project management platforms (e.g., Asana, ClickUp, Trello).

Clear Executive Communication: Advanced written and spoken English skills to articulate creative briefs, coordinate remote teams, and report to US leadership.

title: Project Manager
description:
ABOUT US



Kipkeh Media is an expanding US-based media network specializing in vlogs, local business features, promotional videos, and community-focused content.



We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and resourceful Project Manager to oversee our day-to-day production operations, coordinate a remote team, and ensure projects move efficiently from planning to completion.



This role requires more than task delegation and deadline monitoring. We need someone who can take a big-picture view, stay several steps ahead, recognize potential bottlenecks, and make informed decisions to keep the entire operation organized and productive.



The right candidate is a natural planner who takes responsibility, works independently, and knows how to keep people and projects moving in the right direction.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Production & Project Coordination: Manage the complete content production cycle, covering raw material collection, editing, quality checks, approvals, and publishing. Coordinate several ongoing projects, set schedules, track milestones, and ensure deliverables are completed within agreed timelines.



Remote Team Leadership: Supervise and coordinate remote personnel, including content creators, intake specialists, and video editors. Assign responsibilities, establish clear expectations, address workflow concerns, and maintain consistent team accountability.



Strategic Planning & Execution: Stay ahead of upcoming assignments, anticipate possible delays, and identify scheduling or resource conflicts early. Organize priorities, make necessary adjustments, and take action before small issues develop into larger operational problems.



Production & Quality Control: Oversee incoming content and production progress, identify areas requiring attention, and communicate specific feedback or editing directions. Ensure the team follows established workflows, production guidelines, and quality standards.



Performance Tracking & Reporting: Keep project management sheets, production calendars, and task trackers accurate and organized. Monitor completion rates, communicate progress, flag outstanding work, and identify opportunities to improve team productivity and operational efficiency.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- At least 2 years of relevant experience in project management, operations management, or production coordination.

- Previous experience supervising remote employees and handling multiple projects at once.

- Excellent planning, organizational, and scheduling capabilities.

- A self-driven professional who anticipates what needs to be done rather than waiting for instructions.

- Strong decision-making, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to lead people, manage changing workloads, and work with minimal supervision.

- Open to constructive feedback and committed to professional development.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable working with Google Workspace, Slack, and project management platforms.

- Background in media production, content operations, or video editing workflows is an advantage.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success in this position means having a well-coordinated production operation where projects progress according to schedule, team members understand their responsibilities, and potential issues are addressed before they disrupt the workflow.



We want someone who can independently recognize the next steps, maintain operational structure, and make sure nothing important falls through the cracks.



Most importantly, we value someone who brings initiative, sound judgment, accountability, and practical solutions to the team.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



- $5.00–$6 USD/hour, depending on experience and capabilities.

- Full-time position, 40 hours per week.

- Fully remote working arrangement.

- Weekly payments through Wise.

- Opportunity for professional development and career advancement as the company grows.



HOW TO APPLY



Please read and follow the application requirements below.



 Subject: Project Manager - Your Full Name



Submit ONE Google Drive or iCloud link(with sharing permissions set to "Anyone with the link can view") containing the following:



1. Updated Resume/CV outlining your relevant experience and qualifications.

2. Screenshot of your computer specifications (16GB RAM or higher preferred).

3. Screenshots of your primary and backup internet speed test results.

4. A photo of your dedicated home office or workstation.

5. Evidence of your backup power arrangement (UPS, power station, generator, or solar system).



We are looking for someone dependable, organized, forward-thinking, and comfortable taking responsibility for keeping a growing production team running efficiently.

If you have the experience, initiative, and leadership approach we're looking for, we would be glad to hear from you. Please ensure that your application includes all the requested information and follows the submission instructions above.
